definitions.explanation: A motorcycle. A somewhat older or colloquial word, originally distinguishing a solo motorcycle from one with a sidecar.

examples.japanese: {単車|たんしゃ}で{通勤|つうきん}している。
{若|わか}いころは{単車|たんしゃ}が{好|す}きだった。
examples.english: When I was young I liked motorcycles.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{昔|むかし}、{単車|たんしゃ}で{日本|にほん}{中|じゅう}を{旅|たび}したそうだ。
examples.english: My father apparently traveled all over Japan by motorcycle long ago.

notes:
An older, somewhat colloquial word for a motorcycle. The name (literally 'single vehicle') originally contrasted a motorcycle alone with one fitted with a sidecar. It can sound dated; younger speakers usually say バイク.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- バイク: motorcycle — the standard everyday word today
- オートバイ: motorcycle — slightly more formal, used in writing and traffic contexts
- {自転車|じてんしゃ}: bicycle — a different vehicle, not motorized
